{"name":"editor_toolset.toolsets.python_scripting.PythonScriptingTools","version":"1.0","description":"Executes arbitrary, unsandboxed Python in the editor with full access to the
    `unreal` module, and searches the generated Python API stubs.

    Last resort only. Always prefer a purpose-built toolset for any task one
    covers. Reach for this solely when no other toolset exposes the needed
    functionality, or when the user explicitly asks for a custom Python script.","tools":[{"description":"Returns the definition of a class, function, method, or property from the stub.

Pass a top-level name ('EditorActorSubsystem', 'log') or a qualified
'Class.member'. A free function or a qualified member returns its full
signature and docstring. A class returns its complete effective API: every
editor property (including inherited ones and those set only via
get_editor_property) and every method, own and inherited, as a compact
signature index grouped by the class that declares each. Read a member's
full documentation by requesting it as 'Class.member'.","name":"editor_toolset.toolsets.python_scripting.PythonScriptingTools.get_symbol","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","description":"Top-level class or function name, or a qualified 'Class.member'."}},"required":["name"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"Valor del resultado."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Searches the Unreal Python API stub for class, function, method, and property definitions.

Matches the pattern against each definition line and ignores everything
else, so results are usable symbols rather than incidental mentions. Feed a
result's qualified_name to get_symbol to read it. Note that only properties
with an accessor are found here; a type's full property set, including
those reachable only via get_editor_property, comes from get_symbol.","name":"editor_toolset.toolsets.python_scripting.PythonScriptingTools.search_symbols","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"pattern":{"type":"string","description":"Case-insensitive regular expression."},"max_results":{"type":"integer","description":"Maximum number of matches to return.","default":100},"names_only":{"type":"boolean","description":"When True, match only the symbol's own name (for a method or property, the member name without the owning class). When False, match the whole definition line, so return and parameter types are searchable too, at the cost of also matching text inside default argument values.","default":false}},"required":["pattern"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"array","items":{"title":"StubSymbol","type":"object","properties":{"line_number":{"type":"integer","default":0},"signature":{"type":"string","default":""},"qualified_name":{"type":"string","default":""},"kind":{"type":"string","default":""}}}}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Searches the Unreal Python API stub for lines matching a pattern, anywhere.

A plain text search over every line, including docstrings and bodies. Use
it to find a concept by wording ('nanite', 'collision preset') when you do
not know a symbol name. To find definitions by name, prefer search_symbols.","name":"editor_toolset.toolsets.python_scripting.PythonScriptingTools.grep_stubs","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"pattern":{"type":"string","description":"Case-insensitive regular expression matched against each line."},"max_results":{"type":"integer","description":"Maximum number of matches to return.","default":100}},"required":["pattern"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"array","items":{"title":"StubLine","type":"object","properties":{"text":{"type":"string","default":""},"line_number":{"type":"integer","default":0}}}}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Runs a Python script in the editor's interpreter on the game thread.

IMPORTANT: Call `read_me` once per conversation before using this tool,
for full usage instructions -- including how to compose other tools,
yield control during long-running work, and whether spatial-coordinate
conversion helpers are available this session.","name":"editor_toolset.toolsets.python_scripting.PythonScriptingTools.execute_python","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"script":{"title":"CodeBlock","description":"Code block whose content is the Python source to execute. May contain top-level `await`.","type":"object","properties":{"content":{"type":"string","description":"Texto fuente del bloque de código.","default":""},"language":{"type":"string","title":"ECodeBlockLanguage","enum":["Unspecified","Cpp","Verse","Python","Markdown","HTML","CSS","JavaScript","TypeScript"],"description":"Lenguaje en el que está escrito el contenido. Value display names: Cpp = "C++".","default":"Unspecified"}}}},"required":["script"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"Valor del resultado."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Usage instructions for execute_python. Call this once per conversation
before using execute_python.

Explains the execution environment (namespace, async/await, composing
other tools) and, only when relevant, the spatial coordinate-conversion
helpers available in the current editor session.","name":"editor_toolset.toolsets.python_scripting.PythonScriptingTools.read_me","inputSchema":{"type":"object"},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"Usage instructions as plain text."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}}]}
